column1: # Motion Prompt catalog (en) · 48 elements · https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/ · columns: id
column6: summary
An app icon pops in with a bounce, then a notification badge pops in a moment later.
Chart bars rise one after another from the left, each slightly delayed.
A like heart fills in, and a ring, lines and dots burst outward at the same moment.
A chart line draws itself on, and is later erased from its starting end.
Headline text slides out from behind an invisible edge marked by a single line.
Text is typed into an input field one character at a time, then the send button lights up and is pressed.
A number races upward and locks onto its final value.

column4: Kinetic typography (キネティックタイポグラフィ)
column6: Words move the way they mean: one stretches, one bounces, one spins, one slams down.
Two squares cover the same distance in the same time: the top one at constant speed, the bottom one eased.
A gauge needle swings past its target, comes back and settles.

column4: Squash & stretch (スクワッシュ＆ストレッチ)
column6: A bouncing character squashes on landing and stretches as it takes off.
A shape changes smoothly from circle to square to star to heart, with its colour.

column4: Liquid motion (リキッドモーション)
column6: A blob stretches out, breaks into drops and merges back into one.

column4: Motion trail (モーショントレイル)
column6: A ball moving in a figure eight leaves a fading trail of copies behind it.
Particles keep shooting up from an emitter, spread out and fall.
A landscape pans sideways; near layers move more and far layers move less, creating depth.

column4: Mask transition (マスクトランジション)
column6: A circle- or star-shaped window grows, showing the next scene inside it.

column4: Shape transition (シェイプトランジション)
column6: Coloured bands sweep across and cover the frame; when they leave, the next scene is there.

column4: Liquid transition (リキッドトランジション)
column6: Paint-like liquid drips down from the top and fills the frame, becoming the next scene.
The camera pushes into the hole of a letter O and comes out in the next scene.
A card turns over around its vertical axis and shows its other side.
A band of light crosses the surface of a logo badge at an angle.
Text slices shift sideways, colours split and small bars appear, with no brightness flashing.

column4: Impact shake (インパクトシェイク)
column6: A heavy headline slab drops with a thud and the whole frame shakes from the impact.
The camera stays in place and pivots from left to right; because it is a rotation, near and far layers slide sideways by the same amount.
The camera stays in place and pivots upward, from a person at ground level up to the top of a tower.

column5: dolly,dolly in,push in,track in,move forward,parallax,camera move
column6: The camera itself moves toward the subject; near objects grow and pass quickly while the distant mountains barely change.
The camera does not move; only the focal length gets longer, so the whole picture enlarges by the same ratio.
The camera moves sideways at the same speed as a walking person; the person stays centred while nearer posts sweep past faster.
The camera travels on a circle around the subject; the person stays centred while the trees and buildings behind sweep sideways.
The camera rises while tilting down until it looks down on the person.
The camera pulls back while zooming in by the same ratio; the person keeps the same size and only the background closes in.

column4: Rack focus (ラックフォーカス)
column5: rack focus,focus pull,pull focus,depth of field,blur,bokeh,foreground
column6: The camera does not move; focus shifts from a flower in the foreground to a person behind it, swapping which one is blurred.
Adds a small, irregular shake to the whole frame, as if the camera were held by hand instead of on a tripod.
A first-person view flying low and fast between two rows of trees, banking from side to side.
A level camera rolls around its lens axis and holds with the horizon on a diagonal.

column4: Slow motion (スローモーション)
column6: In front of a fixed camera a person rises and falls slowly through a jump while leaves drift down slowly; the whole action is stretched out.

column5: speed ramp,time remap,ramping,fast to slow,variable speed,velocity
column6: Within one shot the playback speed changes smoothly from fast to slow; a graph at bottom left shows the speed.
With a fixed camera, 06:00 to 18:00 is compressed into a few seconds; sun, clouds, people and shadows move in fast forward.

column4: Freeze frame (フリーズフレーム)
column6: The picture stops at the moment a jumping person reaches the top, then resumes from the same frame 1.4 s later.
Camera position and framing stay the same while the person's position and the clock jump; time is skipped inside one scene.
A thrown ball becomes, in the next shot, a sun at the same position and size; two different scenes are joined on a matching shape.
The camera swings sideways very fast and the next scene is swapped in during the streaked blur.

column4: Cross dissolve (クロスディゾルブ)
column6: The next picture is laid over the current one and its opacity rises until it takes over; both show through each other midway.
A vertical edge moves from left to right and the next picture replaces the current one behind it.

column4: Smash cut (スマッシュカット)
column6: A quiet scene of a person asleep cuts with no warning straight to an intense one; the volume meter jumps at the same moment.

column5: j-cut,j cut,split edit,audio lead,sound first,audio transition,edit
column6: The next scene's audio starts before the picture changes; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.

column5: l-cut,l cut,split edit,audio lag,sound carries over,audio transition,edit
column6: The previous scene's audio carries on for a while after the picture has changed; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.
